reason: My first thought is always whether it's really tested, and here the lab report for my batch is on the page and the batch number on the box matches it. At $24.99 with money back, I'd try one box on TikTok Shop.
objection: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so I might not finish 30 days. And I'd want to open the report myself and see that it's a real lab, not just a line on the page.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be generic or didn't match the batch number, or if the launch price were gone and it was full $29.99 with no sample size.
